_help: To add a project, paste its GitHub link into the matching list below (a plain URL is enough). Optional fields per project: title, description, stack (list), emoji. Any repo that has one of the section's topics on GitHub is also added automatically.

projects.title: LexSportiva-AI
projects.description: An AI sports referee. A multi-sport RAG assistant that answers rules questions from official rulebooks (IFAB, FIBA, IHF, ITF, IBA) with exact page citations and an in-app PDF viewer. Hybrid retrieval (BGE-M3 + BM25) fused with RRF, parent-child chunking, query rewriting and cross-encoder re-ranking, in English and Arabic.

projects.title: ClinicianMind AI
projects.description: Evidence-grounded clinical decision support for adult hypertension, built at the Instant & Orange AI Hackathon (top 5 teams). Answers clinician questions from WHO 2021 and NICE NG136 guidelines with chunk-level citations, two-stage retrieval, safety guardrails (emergency and prompt-injection detection, refusal when grounding is weak) and structured JSON output.

projects.title: Machine Fault Recognition
projects.description: Deep learning for predictive maintenance: classifies machine sounds into six normal and abnormal states across three machine types. Fine-tunes a pretrained CNN14 (PANNs) on log-Mel spectrograms with focal loss and weighted sampling, reaching 95.84% test accuracy (91.31% baseline). Leakage-free splits, ONNX export, Docker and a Hugging Face demo.

projects.title: E-Commerce Microservices
projects.description: A production-style e-commerce backend built as Spring Boot 3 microservices: Config Server, Eureka, API Gateway, and Auth (JWT), Shop, Inventory and Wallet services. Resilient inter-service calls with OpenFeign and circuit breakers, Outbox pattern for consistency, distributed tracing with Zipkin and Docker Compose.

projects.title: Workspace.eg
projects.description: A coworking-space app for Egypt that connects freelancers and students with workspace owners. Real-time availability, transparent pricing, verified reviews, map-based discovery and full Arabic (RTL) and English support, built with Clean Architecture.

projects.title: SignGuard
projects.description: A traffic-sign detection and driver-education app. Detects road signs live from the camera or from gallery images, with an interactive learning section (quizzes and a sign catalog) and spoken feedback in Arabic and English.

projects.title: Lite X
projects.description: A cross-platform X (Twitter) client built by a team of students: For You and Following feeds, posts, replies, reposts and bookmarks, profiles, real-time chat over WebSockets, push notifications, search and trends, in English and Arabic.

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction
projects.description: An end-to-end data science project that identifies customers likely to leave so a business can act early. Covers data exploration, feature engineering, model building and a final MLOps milestone for deployment.

projects.title: TripSync
projects.description: A tour-management platform for admins, travellers and travel agencies: trip booking, agency profiles and reviews, a rewards points system, travel blogs and an admin dashboard with analytics.

projects.title: Alien Invasion
projects.description: A console war simulation between Earth, Alien and Ally armies, each with its own unit types and abilities. Interactive and silent modes, built on hand-made data structures (linked lists, queues, priority queues and stacks).

projects.title: Paint For Kids
projects.description: A paint-and-play desktop app for children: draw and drag shapes with undo and redo, record and replay sessions, save and load drawings, then switch to play mode for colour and shape matching games.

projects.title: Arkanoid
projects.description: The classic Breakout arcade game written in Assembly: paddle control, ball physics, bricks, scoring, lives and multiple levels with rising difficulty.
